{   "summary": "General situation: South American grains and oilseeds markets show stable to firm price levels with Brazilian corn FOB Santos at 112.7 USD/ton and soybeans and wheat in Brazil both at 662.9 USD/ton as of mid-March 2026. US spot prices for corn, soybeans, and wheat remain aligned at 394.45 USD/ton as of early February 2026, indicating steady conditions in North America. Argentine prices for barley and rice are at 212 USD/ton, reflecting regional stability. What changed vs previous comparable period: No direct temporal comparison data is available for the last 30 days, but broker desk activity indicates active trading interest with corn CIF offers at 241 EUR/ton for April shipments and sunflower bids at 301 USD/ton in early March, suggesting ongoing demand in European and Mediterranean markets. Rapeseed trades at 500 EUR/ton for August delivery in Germany highlight firm pricing in the European DAP market. Actionable implications for trading/brokerage: Traders should monitor European rapeseed and corn CIF offers as indicators of firm demand and potential tightening supply. The stable South American prices suggest limited immediate export pressure, while US prices remain steady, supporting a balanced global supply outlook. Brokerage can leverage the active bid/offer spreads in corn and sunflower to facilitate short-term transactions.

uk.text: {   "summary": "Загальна ситуація на ринку зернових та олійних в Україні демонструє стабільність цін на основні експортні позиції, з незначними коливаннями в межах кількох доларів. Ціна кукурудзи CPT Одеса тримається на рівні 215 USD/т, а пропозиції FOB Чорноморськ коливаються в діапазоні 226-229 USD/т, що свідчить про помірний тиск на ринок.
